title: How to escape education's death valley
speaker: Ken Robinson

sentences.en: Translator: Joseph Geni Reviewer: Morton Bast Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢12年前我移居到美国协同我的妻子泰瑞和两个孩子事实上，说真的，我们只是搬到了洛杉矶还以为到了美国

sentences.en: I moved to America 12 years ago with my wife Terry and our two kids.
sentences.zh: 还以为到了美国不过，从洛杉矶乘飞机到美国

sentences.en: Actually, truthfully, we moved to Los Angeles -- (Laughter) thinking we were moving to America, but anyway -- (Laughter) It's a short plane ride from Los Angeles to America.
sentences.zh: 不过，从洛杉矶乘飞机到美国用不了多长时间12年前，我刚来到美国的时候当地人给我讲了许多东西像“美国人不懂讽刺。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) I got here 12 years ago, and when I got here, I was told various things, like, "Americans don't get irony."
sentences.zh: 像“美国人不懂讽刺。”你们也有这种想法吗这很荒谬，我踏遍了美国的山山水水却从未找到任何证据来证明美国人不懂讽刺这属于一种文化迷思

sentences.en: (Laughter) Have you come across this idea?
sentences.zh: 这属于一种文化迷思就如同说“英国人很矜持”一样

sentences.en: It's not true. I've traveled the whole length and breadth of this country.
sentences.zh: 就如同说“英国人很矜持”一样我真不知道人们为何会这样想英国曾侵略过每一个与其不期而遇的国度啊

sentences.en: I have found no evidence that Americans don't get irony.
sentences.zh: 英国曾侵略过每一个与其不期而遇的国度啊（笑声）

sentences.en: It's one of those cultural myths, like, "The British are reserved."
sentences.zh: （笑声）但是说美国人不懂讽刺确实与事实不符

sentences.en: (Laughter) I don't know why people think this.
sentences.zh: 但是说美国人不懂讽刺确实与事实不符其实我只是想令大家知道别人在背后是怎样谈论你的

sentences.en: We've invaded every country we've encountered.
sentences.zh: 别人在背后是怎样谈论你的在欧洲，你离开客厅时

sentences.en: (Laughter) But it's not true Americans don't get irony, but I just want you to know that that's what people are saying about you behind your back.
sentences.zh: 在欧洲，你离开客厅时人们会说，幸好，没人当着你的面讽刺在我偶然听说“不让一个孩子掉队”这条立法时我就知道了美国人是懂得讽刺的

sentences.en: You know, so when you leave living rooms in Europe, people say, thankfully, nobody was ironic in your presence.
sentences.zh: 我就知道了美国人是懂得讽刺的想出这条立法标题的人，就很懂得讽刺

sentences.en: (Laughter) But I knew that Americans get irony when I came across that legislation, "No Child Left Behind."
sentences.zh: 想出这条立法标题的人，就很懂得讽刺难道不是吗，因为--（笑声）（掌声）

sentences.en: (Laughter) Because whoever thought of that title gets irony.
sentences.zh: （笑声）（掌声）因为数百万的儿童被撇在后面了

sentences.en: (Laughter) Don't they? (Applause) Because it's leaving millions of children behind.
sentences.zh: 因为数百万的儿童被撇在后面了我从中看到的是一个并不招人待见的名号“数百万的孩子掉队了”，显而易见具体有什么计划呢？我们提议把数百万儿童撇到后面这就是它如何运作的

sentences.en: Now I can see that's not a very attractive name for legislation: "Millions of Children Left Behind."
sentences.zh: 这就是它如何运作的而且效果不错在美国的部分地区60%的孩子从高中退学

sentences.en: I can see that. What's the plan? We propose to leave millions of children behind, and here's how it's going to work.
sentences.zh: 60%的孩子从高中退学在土著美国人社区达到80%有一种看法是，如果这个数字较少一半

sentences.en: And it's working beautifully. (Laughter) In some parts of the country, 60 percent of kids drop out of high school.
sentences.zh: 有一种看法是，如果这个数字较少一半那么在未来的十年里，可以为美国的经济

sentences.en: In the Native American communities, it's 80 percent of kids.
sentences.zh: 那么在未来的十年里，可以为美国的经济创造近万亿美元的净利润

sentences.en: If we halved that number, one estimate is it would create a net gain to the U.S. economy over 10 years, of nearly a trillion dollars.
sentences.zh: 创造近万亿美元的净利润从经济角度看这是一笔好买卖，对吧，但我们应该这样做吗？实际上，要大量的投入才能肃清辍学危机所造成的损害

sentences.en: From an economic point of view, this is good math, isn't it, that we should do this?
sentences.zh: 但辍学危机仅仅是冰山一角没算在内的是那些人在上学

sentences.en: It actually costs an enormous amount to mop up the damage from the dropout crisis.
sentences.zh: 没算在内的是那些人在上学心却辍了学的孩子，他们不喜欢学习无法真正从中获益

sentences.en: But the dropout crisis is just the tip of an iceberg.
sentences.zh: 无法真正从中获益其原因不是我们没有投入足够的钱

sentences.en: What it doesn't count are all the kids who are in school but being disengaged from it, who don't enjoy it, who don't get any real benefit from it.
sentences.zh: 不是我们没有投入足够的钱在教育领域，美国比大多数国家投入了更多的资金班级人数也更少每年都有上千条立法提案

sentences.en: And the reason is not that we're not spending enough money.
sentences.zh: 每年都有上千条立法提案尝试改善教育制度问题是，我们走错了方向

sentences.en: America spends more money on education than most other countries.
sentences.zh: 问题是，我们走错了方向

sentences.en: Class sizes are smaller than in many countries.
sentences.zh: 问题是，我们走错了方向有三条法则可以让我们的生活更加繁荣

sentences.en: And there are hundreds of initiatives every year to try and improve education.
sentences.zh: 可以让我们的生活更加繁荣而现行的教育文化却与之相抵触

sentences.en: The trouble is, it's all going in the wrong direction.
sentences.zh: 而现行的教育文化却与之相抵触多数教师教得辛苦

sentences.en: There are three principles on which human life flourishes, and they are contradicted by the culture of education under which most teachers have to labor and most students have to endure.
sentences.zh: 学生学的痛苦第一条法则是，人类天生彼此千差万别请问一下，在座各位多少人有孩子

sentences.en: The first is this, that human beings are naturally different and diverse.
sentences.zh: 孙儿辈也算两个或两个以上的呢

sentences.en: Can I ask you, how many of you have got children of your own?
sentences.zh: 剩下的即使没有孩子也见过别人的孩子（笑声）

sentences.en: Okay. Or grandchildren. How about two children or more? Right.
sentences.zh: 到处都有小孩子我要跟你们打个赌我肯定能赌赢

sentences.en: And the rest of you have seen such children.
sentences.zh: 如果你有两个以上的孩子我打赌，他们一定是完全不同的个体

sentences.en: (Laughter) Small people wandering about.
sentences.zh: 我打赌，他们一定是完全不同的个体不是吗？难道不是吗？（鼓掌）

sentences.en: (Laughter) I will make you a bet, and I am confident that I will win the bet.
sentences.zh: 不是吗？难道不是吗？（鼓掌）你绝对不会错认，对不对

sentences.en: If you've got two children or more, I bet you they are completely different from each other.
sentences.zh: 你绝对不会错认，对不对你可不会说“你是哪一个，提醒我一下我和你妈妈要采用些手段

sentences.en: Aren't they? (Applause) You would never confuse them, would you?
sentences.zh: 我和你妈妈要采用些手段像彩色编码系统，这样我们就不会搞错了。”“不让一个孩子掉队”所提出的教育政策

sentences.en: Like, "Which one are you? Remind me." (Laughter) "Your mother and I need some color-coding system so we don't get confused."
sentences.zh: “不让一个孩子掉队”所提出的教育政策是基于一致性而非多样性这种政策是在鼓励校方以成绩的高低这种狭隘的方式来为儿童的能力定位

sentences.en: Education under "No Child Left Behind" is based on not diversity but conformity.
sentences.zh: 这种狭隘的方式来为儿童的能力定位“不让一个孩子掉队”这条立法的一个影响便是将公众的视线限制在被称作STEM学科的焦点上

sentences.en: What schools are encouraged to do is to find out what kids can do across a very narrow spectrum of achievement.
sentences.zh: [STEM:科学、技术、工程、数学]它们很重要。我不是驳斥科学和数学的重要性正相反，它们是必需的，但不是全部

sentences.en: One of the effects of "No Child Left Behind" has been to narrow the focus onto the so-called STEM disciplines.
sentences.zh: 正相反，它们是必需的，但不是全部真正的教育应当给予艺术、人文和体育与STEM同等重要的地位

sentences.en: They're very important. I'm not here to argue against science and math.
sentences.zh: 与STEM同等重要的地位有太多的学生，对不起，谢谢-（鼓掌声）-

sentences.en: On the contrary, they're necessary but they're not sufficient.
sentences.zh: 有太多的学生，对不起，谢谢-（鼓掌声）-

sentences.en: A real education has to give equal weight to the arts, the humanities, to physical education.
sentences.zh: 有太多的学生，对不起，谢谢-（鼓掌声）-据估计，如今的美国有大约10%的儿童

sentences.en: An awful lot of kids, sorry, thank you -- (Applause) One estimate in America currently is that something like 10 percent of kids, getting on that way,
sentences.zh: 有大约10%的儿童被诊断出患有注意力缺乏症的一些症状即注意缺陷多动障碍。我不否定有这样的病症存在

sentences.en: are being diagnosed with various conditions under the broad title of attention deficit disorder.
sentences.zh: 即注意缺陷多动障碍。我不否定有这样的病症存在只是我不认为这种病会如此盛行如果你叫孩子坐上几个小时做低级的文书工作

sentences.en: ADHD. I'm not saying there's no such thing.
sentences.zh: 做低级的文书工作他们会不安分，这并不奇怪

sentences.en: I just don't believe it's an epidemic like this.
sentences.zh: （笑声）（掌声）

sentences.en: If you sit kids down, hour after hour, doing low-grade clerical work, don't be surprised if they start to fidget, you know?
sentences.zh: （笑声）（掌声）大多数的孩子并没有心理问题他们只是在忍受童年的煎熬而已

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) Children are not, for the most part, suffering from a psychological condition.
sentences.zh: 他们只是在忍受童年的煎熬而已之所以这样讲，是因为我也有过早期的童年生涯并经历了整个历程

sentences.en: They're suffering from childhood. (Laughter) And I know this because I spent my early life as a child.
sentences.zh: 并经历了整个历程广泛的课程可以使孩子们取得最出色的成就可以展示出他们多方面的天分不局限于小范围顺便提一下，艺术之所以重要

sentences.en: I went through the whole thing. Kids prosper best with a broad curriculum that celebrates their various talents, not just a small range of them.
sentences.zh: 顺便提一下，艺术之所以重要不只是因为它能够提高数学成绩艺术之所以重要，是因为它表述着孩子们的天性与本质第二条法则，谢谢-（掌声）

sentences.en: And by the way, the arts aren't just important because they improve math scores.
sentences.zh: 第二条法则，谢谢-（掌声）要想生活的朝气蓬勃，第二条法则是

sentences.en: They're important because they speak to parts of children's being which are otherwise untouched.
sentences.zh: 要想生活的朝气蓬勃，第二条法则是拥有好奇心

sentences.en: The second, thank you -- (Applause) The second principle that drives human life flourishing is curiosity.
sentences.zh: 拥有好奇心如果你能燃起孩子心性的好奇之火绝大多数，都可以主动学习，无需外援孩子们天生就会学习是激发或是扼杀这种天赋

sentences.en: If you can light the spark of curiosity in a child, they will learn without any further assistance, very often.
sentences.zh: 是激发或是扼杀这种天赋对孩子会产生巨大的影响好奇心是取得成就的能动力

sentences.en: Children are natural learners. It's a real achievement to put that particular ability out, or to stifle it.
sentences.zh: 好奇心是取得成就的能动力我这么说是因为如果可以这么说的话，当前的教育文化影响了教师的专业化程度

sentences.en: Curiosity is the engine of achievement. Now the reason I say this is because one of the effects of the current culture here, if I can say so, has been to de-professionalize teachers.
sentences.zh: 影响了教师的专业化程度无论是世界范围的教育体系还是国家内部的教育机构都不如优秀的教学团队教师是学校能否取得成功的命脉

sentences.en: There is no system in the world or any school in the country that is better than its teachers.
sentences.zh: 教师是学校能否取得成功的命脉教学是需要创造力的职业教学，要有适当的创作，因为它不是单纯的输出教师的工作不仅仅去传递所接收到的信息

sentences.en: Teachers are the lifeblood of the success of schools.
sentences.zh: 教师的工作不仅仅去传递所接收到的信息优秀的教师的确要这样做

sentences.en: But teaching is a creative profession. Teaching, properly conceived, is not a delivery system.
sentences.zh: 但同时他们还会指导学生的学习激发学生的兴趣，挑起学生的热情，赢得学生的关注

sentences.en: You know, you're not there just to pass on received information.
sentences.zh: 看吧，总而言之，教育讲的就是学习如果没有学习

sentences.en: Great teachers do that, but what great teachers also do is mentor, stimulate, provoke, engage.
sentences.zh: 如果没有学习就谈不上教育人们花了大量时间去谈教育问题却从来不讲学习教育的主旨就是引导人们去学习

sentences.en: You see, in the end, education is about learning.
sentences.zh: 教育的主旨就是引导人们去学习我的一个朋友，是老朋友了--他本身也很老了

sentences.en: If there's no learning going on, there's no education going on.
sentences.zh: 我的一个朋友，是老朋友了--他本身也很老了已经去世了（笑声）

sentences.en: And people can spend an awful lot of time discussing education without ever discussing learning.
sentences.zh: 已经去世了（笑声）恐怕最老也不过如此了

sentences.en: The whole point of education is to get people to learn.
sentences.zh: 恐怕最老也不过如此了

sentences.en: An old friend of mine -- actually very old, he's dead.
sentences.zh: 恐怕最老也不过如此了他是个很了不起的人，是位出色的哲学家

sentences.en: (Laughter) That's as old as it gets, I'm afraid.
sentences.zh: 他是个很了不起的人，是位出色的哲学家他过去常谈到做事与从中获得成就感两者之间的不同

sentences.en: (Laughter) But a wonderful guy he was, wonderful philosopher.
sentences.zh: 两者之间的不同有些事你会去做但不一定有所成就就好比节食，这是个非常典型的例子

sentences.en: He used to talk about the difference between the task and achievement senses of verbs.
sentences.zh: 就好比节食，这是个非常典型的例子你看他，他最近在节食。他有瘦一些吗？没有啊

sentences.en: You can be engaged in the activity of something, but not really be achieving it, like dieting.
sentences.zh: 你看他，他最近在节食。他有瘦一些吗？没有啊教学和节食很像你可以说“那就是黛博拉，她在34号教室授课。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) It's a very good example. There he is. He's dieting.
sentences.zh: 你可以说“那就是黛博拉，她在34号教室授课。”但如果学生没从她那学到任何知识她就可能只是从事教学这项工作

sentences.en: Is he losing any weight? Not really. (Laughter) Teaching is a word like that.
sentences.zh: 她就可能只是从事教学这项工作但并没有真正的完成它教师的职责是令学生学习得更容易，就是这样

sentences.en: You can say, "There's Deborah, she's in room 34, she's teaching."
sentences.zh: 教师的职责是令学生学习得更容易，就是这样我想，部分原因是

sentences.en: But if nobody's learning anything, she may be engaged in the task of teaching but not actually fulfilling it.
sentences.zh: 我想，部分原因是因为当下的教育文化主要关注的是考试，而非教学

sentences.en: The role of a teacher is to facilitate learning.
sentences.zh: 是考试，而非教学如今，考试很重要，标准化考试很有影响力

sentences.en: That's it. And part of the problem is, I think, that the dominant culture of education has come to focus on not teaching and learning, but testing.
sentences.zh: 如今，考试很重要，标准化考试很有影响力但它不应该作为教育文化的主导方向相反，考试应该用于诊断问题。并且，用于帮助改进（掌声）

sentences.en: Now, testing is important. Standardized tests have a place.
sentences.zh: （掌声）

sentences.en: But they should not be the dominant culture of education.
sentences.zh: （掌声）如果我去做个医学检查我当然要做些常规检查

sentences.en: They should be diagnostic. They should help.
sentences.zh: 我当然要做些常规检查

sentences.en: (Applause) If I go for a medical examination, I want some standardized tests.
sentences.zh: 我当然要做些常规检查我想知道，同大众标准值范围相比我的胆固醇含量在什么水平我不想参考那些医生随便编出来的数值“你的胆固醇含量在橙色水平。”

sentences.en: I do. I want to know what my cholesterol level is compared to everybody else's on a standard scale.
sentences.zh: “你的胆固醇含量在橙色水平。”“真的？是好消息？”“没法判断。”

sentences.en: I don't want to be told on some scale my doctor invented in the car.
sentences.zh: “真的？是好消息？”“没法判断。”但这些考试应当对学习有利，不应该像常表现出的

sentences.en: (Laughter) "Your cholesterol is what I call Level Orange."
sentences.zh: 但这些考试应当对学习有利，不应该像常表现出的阻挠学习的热情

sentences.en: "Really?" (Laughter) "Is that good?" "We don't know."
sentences.zh: 阻挠学习的热情当前教育的文化核心，不是激发好奇心而是要求服从

sentences.en: (Laughter) But all that should support learning.
sentences.zh: 而是要求服从我们的孩子和教师都被鼓励遵循常规算法

sentences.en: It shouldn't obstruct it, which of course it often does.
sentences.zh: 遵循常规算法而不是激发想象力与好奇心

sentences.en: So in place of curiosity, what we have is a culture of compliance.
sentences.zh: 而不是激发想象力与好奇心第三条法则是人的生命具有与生俱来的创造力

sentences.en: Our children and teachers are encouraged to follow routine algorithms rather than to excite that power of imagination and curiosity.
sentences.zh: 人的生命具有与生俱来的创造力这就解释了为什么我们有不同的人生履历我们创造不同的生活我们一边经历着一边享受着这是作为人类通用的生活模式

sentences.en: And the third principle is this: that human life is inherently creative.
sentences.zh: 这是作为人类通用的生活模式这就是为什么人类文化如此有趣、丰富

sentences.en: It's why we all have different résumés. We create our lives, and we can recreate them as we go through them.
sentences.zh: 充满活力其他动物也可能拥有想象力和创造力，但明显又没那么多不是吗，难道跟人类一样？

sentences.en: It's the common currency of being a human being.
sentences.zh: 不是吗，难道跟人类一样？你可能养了条狗

sentences.en: It's why human culture is so interesting and diverse and dynamic.
sentences.zh: 你可能养了条狗你的狗也有可能情绪低落

sentences.en: I mean, other animals may well have imaginations and creativity, but it's not so much in evidence, is it, as ours?
sentences.zh: 你的狗也有可能情绪低落但它不会去听收音机头乐队的音乐，不是吗？（笑声）它也不会拿着酒瓶坐在窗前凝视远方

sentences.en: I mean, you may have a dog. And your dog may get depressed.
sentences.zh: 它也不会拿着酒瓶坐在窗前凝视远方（笑声）

sentences.en: You know, but it doesn't listen to Radiohead, does it?
sentences.zh: （笑声）你问“要不要出去散散步啊？”

sentences.en: (Laughter) And sit staring out the window with a bottle of Jack Daniels.
sentences.zh: 你问“要不要出去散散步啊？”它回答“不用了，我没事。你去吧，我在这等你。记得拍照。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) "Would you like to come for a walk?"
sentences.zh: 你去吧，我在这等你。记得拍照。”我们的生活就建立在这种无休止的经历上设想着其他的选择，其他的可能

sentences.en: "No, I'm fine." (Laughter) "You go. I'll wait. But take pictures."
sentences.zh: 设想着其他的选择，其他的可能而教育的一个作用就是唤醒并开发人们的创造力

sentences.en: (Laughter) We all create our own lives through this restless process of imagining alternatives and possibilities, and one of the roles of education is to awaken and develop these powers of creativity.
sentences.zh: 就是唤醒并开发人们的创造力相反，我们的教育文化是标准定型的其实不是非得这样做，不是的在芬兰，传统优势教学科目有数学、科学以及阅读

sentences.en: Instead, what we have is a culture of standardization.
sentences.zh: 数学、科学以及阅读我们只知道他们在这些方面做得很好

sentences.en: Now, it doesn't have to be that way. It really doesn't.
sentences.zh: 因为这些科目通常都是要考试的这就是考试引发的一个问题人们会忽视同等重要的其他科目

sentences.en: Finland regularly comes out on top in math, science and reading.
sentences.zh: 人们会忽视同等重要的其他科目在芬兰教育工作是这样的：人们并不执著于这些学科

sentences.en: Now, we only know that's what they do well at, because that's all that's being tested.
sentences.zh: 人们并不执著于这些学科他们的教育很全面

sentences.en: That's one of the problems of the test. They don't look for other things that matter just as much.
sentences.zh: 他们的教育很全面包括人文、体育和艺术领域

sentences.en: The thing about work in Finland is this: they don't obsess about those disciplines.
sentences.zh: 包括人文、体育和艺术领域其次，在芬兰没有标准化考试

sentences.en: They have a very broad approach to education, which includes humanities, physical education, the arts.
sentences.zh: 其次，在芬兰没有标准化考试我是说，几乎没有即使有也不会是那种叫人要一大早起床守在桌旁学习才能通过的考试

sentences.en: Second, there is no standardized testing in Finland.
sentences.zh: 第三，最近我出席了一个会议对方来自芬兰，是的的确确的芬兰人一些美国人

sentences.en: I mean, there's a bit, but it's not what gets people up in the morning, what keeps them at their desks.
sentences.zh: 一些美国人向芬兰人问道“在芬兰，你们怎么应对辍学率？”

sentences.en: The third thing -- and I was at a meeting recently with some people from Finland, actual Finnish people, and somebody from the American system was saying to the people in Finland, "What do you do about the drop-out rate in Finland?"
sentences.zh: “在芬兰，你们怎么应对辍学率？”他们当下看起来很困惑，然后说“我们那没人辍学为什么要辍学呢？如果有人遇到困难，我们会很快的联系他们帮助他们，甚至支持他们。”有人会说“要知道

sentences.en: And they all looked a bit bemused, and said, "Well, we don't have one.
sentences.zh: 有人会说“要知道你不能拿芬兰同美国比。”的确不能，芬兰人口

sentences.en: Why would you drop out? If people are in trouble, we get to them quite quickly and we help and support them."
sentences.zh: 的确不能，芬兰人口只有大约五百万但可以拿它同美国的一个州来比较

sentences.en: Now people always say, "Well, you know, you can't compare Finland to America."
sentences.zh: 但可以拿它同美国的一个州来比较在美国许多州的人口比芬兰的要少我去过美国的一些州

sentences.en: No. I think there's a population of around five million in Finland.
sentences.zh: 我去过美国的一些州那里就我一个人（笑声）

sentences.en: But you can compare it to a state in America.
sentences.zh: 那里就我一个人（笑声）这是真的。还有人告诉我走之前要锁门

sentences.en: Many states in America have fewer people in them than that.
sentences.zh: 这是真的。还有人告诉我走之前要锁门（笑声）

sentences.en: I mean, I've been to some states in America and I was the only person there.
sentences.zh: （笑声）但是世界上所有的高效体系

sentences.en: (Laughter) Really. I was asked to lock up when I left.
sentences.zh: 但是世界上所有的高效体系用在美国身上，很遗憾通常作用都不明显--作为整体而言

sentences.en: (Laughter) But what all the high-performing systems in the world do is currently what is not evident, sadly, across the systems in America --
sentences.zh: 通常作用都不明显--作为整体而言做法之一是，他们将教学个性化他们认为学生是学习的主体教育体系要做到吸引他们，引起他们的好奇心

sentences.en: I mean, as a whole. One is this: they individualize teaching and learning.
sentences.zh: 教育体系要做到吸引他们，引起他们的好奇心他们的个性以及创造力这样才能让学生主动学习

sentences.en: They recognize that it's students who are learning and the system has to engage them, their curiosity, their individuality, and their creativity.
sentences.zh: 第二种做法是，他们为教育行业造就了崇高的地位他们意识到要改善教育水平

sentences.en: That's how you get them to learn. The second is that they attribute a very high status to the teaching profession.
sentences.zh: 就要选择优秀的教员并给予他们不断的支持以及专业化的发展投资教育专业的发展不是单纯的花费它是有收益的

sentences.en: They recognize that you can't improve education if you don't pick great people to teach and keep giving them constant support and professional development.
sentences.zh: 它是有收益的所有在教育方面取得成功的国家都深知这一点无论是澳大利亚、加拿大、韩国、新加坡

sentences.en: Investing in professional development is not a cost.
sentences.zh: 无论是澳大利亚、加拿大、韩国、新加坡香港还是上海，他们知道事实就是这样

sentences.en: It's an investment, and every other country that's succeeding well knows that, whether it's Australia, Canada, South Korea, Singapore, Hong Kong or Shanghai.
sentences.zh: 香港还是上海，他们知道事实就是这样第三种做法是，他们帮助校方知道他们的责任所在并且要求校方负起他们应有的责任大家可以看出这与我们教育体系中的指挥和控制模式差异巨大

sentences.en: They know that to be the case. And the third is, they devolve responsibility to the school level for getting the job done.
sentences.zh: 我们教育体系中的指挥和控制模式差异巨大但这的确是某些教育体系的真实情况中央政府或州政府认为他们是最好的决策者，他们会告诉你做什么

sentences.en: You see, there's a big difference here between going into a mode of command and control in education -- That's what happens in some systems.
sentences.zh: 他们是最好的决策者，他们会告诉你做什么问题是人们不会在立法机构的会议室里进行教学

sentences.en: Central or state governments decide, they know best and they're going to tell you what to do.
sentences.zh: 会议室里进行教学而是在教室和校园里讲授者是教师，受教者是学生

sentences.en: The trouble is that education doesn't go on in the committee rooms of our legislative buildings.
sentences.zh: 讲授者是教师，受教者是学生若要夺走他们的决定权，教育体系就无法正常运行政府必须把决定权交还给人们

sentences.en: It happens in classrooms and schools, and the people who do it are the teachers and the students, and if you remove their discretion, it stops working.
sentences.zh: 政府必须把决定权交还给人们（掌声）美国的教育工作还是很出色的我得承认这一点

sentences.en: You have to put it back to the people. (Applause) There is wonderful work happening in this country.
sentences.zh: 我得承认这一点尽管在这种教育文化下却不受其干扰就像有人总是逆风航行我认为原因就是

sentences.en: But I have to say it's happening in spite of the dominant culture of education, not because of it.
sentences.zh: 当前的许多政策都是基于对教育的刻板印象

sentences.en: It's like people are sailing into a headwind all the time.
sentences.zh: 对教育的刻板印象他们认为教育就像一种工业流程

sentences.en: And the reason I think is this: that many of the current policies are based on mechanistic conceptions of education.
sentences.zh: 他们认为教育就像一种工业流程只要有了更好的数据便有更好的发展我想决策者会有这种想法源于这样一种观点如果我们将数据调整的足够精确

sentences.en: It's like education is an industrial process that can be improved just by having better data, and somewhere in the back of the mind of some policy makers is this idea that if we fine-tune it well enough, if we just get it right,
sentences.zh: 如果我们将数据调整的足够精确整个体系在将来都会运转的很好其实不会的，永远都不会因为教育不是机械化的系统它是人性化的，它的主体是人

sentences.en: it will all hum along perfectly into the future.
sentences.zh: 它是人性化的，它的主体是人想学习的人，不想学习的人

sentences.en: It won't, and it never did. The point is that education is not a mechanical system.
sentences.zh: 想学习的人，不想学习的人每一个辍学的学生都有自己的理由源于每个人不同的生活经历

sentences.en: It's a human system. It's about people, people who either do want to learn or don't want to learn.
sentences.zh: 源于每个人不同的生活经历或许是觉得学习很无聊，或许认为学的东西无关紧要也或者是他们发现这些

sentences.en: Every student who drops out of school has a reason for it which is rooted in their own biography.
sentences.zh: 也或者是他们发现这些与校园以外的生活相矛盾大潮流始终存在，但每个人独特的故事，同样存在最近我在洛杉矶参与了一个会议

sentences.en: They may find it boring. They may find it irrelevant.
sentences.zh: 最近我在洛杉矶参与了一个会议被称为可选择的教育方案

sentences.en: They may find that it's at odds with the life they're living outside of school.
sentences.zh: 被称为可选择的教育方案策划这些方案的目的是要让孩子重新接受教育

sentences.en: There are trends, but the stories are always unique.
sentences.zh: 策划这些方案的目的是要让孩子重新接受教育他们有些共同特征个性化程度高

sentences.en: I was at a meeting recently in Los Angeles of -- they're called alternative education programs.
sentences.zh: 个性化程度高对教员支持力度大与社区联系紧密

sentences.en: These are programs designed to get kids back into education.
sentences.zh: 与社区联系紧密课程广泛多样化这些课程方案往往将

sentences.en: They have certain common features. They're very personalized.
sentences.zh: 这些课程方案往往将校外和校内的学生都包含了进来

sentences.en: They have strong support for the teachers, close links with the community and a broad and diverse curriculum, and often programs which involve students outside school as well as inside school.
sentences.zh: 校外和校内的学生都包含了进来而且都很奏效有趣的是这些被称作“可选择性教育”想想看环顾世界所有的证据都显示如果我们都这样做，那就不存在选不选择的问题了

sentences.en: And they work. What's interesting to me is, these are called "alternative education."
sentences.zh: 如果我们都这样做，那就不存在选不选择的问题了（掌声）

sentences.en: (Laughter) You know? And all the evidence from around the world is, if we all did that, there'd be no need for the alternative.
sentences.zh: （掌声）所以我想我们应该采用一种不同的说法我们应当认识到这是个人性化的体系

sentences.en: (Applause) (Applause ends) So I think we have to embrace a different metaphor.
sentences.zh: 我们应当认识到这是个人性化的体系在一些环境下人们可以取得成功有些却不能毕竟我们都是有机的生命体而校园文化绝对是我们最根本的成长要素

sentences.en: We have to recognize that it's a human system, and there are conditions under which people thrive, and conditions under which they don't.
sentences.zh: 而校园文化绝对是我们最根本的成长要素文化也是个有机的术语，不是吗？离我家不远处，有个地方叫死亡谷

sentences.en: We are after all organic creatures, and the culture of the school is absolutely essential.
sentences.zh: 离我家不远处，有个地方叫死亡谷死亡谷是全美最热最干旱的地带在那里没有任何生物可以存活

sentences.en: Culture is an organic term, isn't it? Not far from where I live is a place called Death Valley.
sentences.zh: 在那里没有任何生物可以存活因为那里从不下雨所以，它叫做死亡谷

sentences.en: Death Valley is the hottest, driest place in America, and nothing grows there.
sentences.zh: 所以，它叫做死亡谷2004年冬天，死亡谷却下起了雨

sentences.en: Nothing grows there because it doesn't rain.
sentences.zh: 短时间内降雨量达七英寸

sentences.en: Hence, Death Valley. In the winter of 2004, it rained in Death Valley.
sentences.zh: 短时间内降雨量达七英寸2005年春天，那里出现这样一种景色整个死亡谷铺满了鲜花

sentences.en: Seven inches of rain fell over a very short period.
sentences.zh: 整个死亡谷铺满了鲜花持续了一段时间

sentences.en: And in the spring of 2005, there was a phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 这证明了一点：死亡谷并非没有生命

sentences.en: The whole floor of Death Valley was carpeted in flowers for a while.
sentences.zh: 它只是在休眠地表下潜伏着的种子

sentences.en: What it proved is this: that Death Valley isn't dead.
sentences.zh: 待条件成熟便伺机而发有机系统内，只要有适当的环境

sentences.en: It's dormant. Right beneath the surface are these seeds of possibility waiting for the right conditions to come about, and with organic systems, if the conditions are right,
sentences.zh: 有机系统内，只要有适当的环境生命的出现不可避免，这是自然规律你选择一个地方，一所学校，一个市区你改变环境，让人们对可能性有了不同的感受对希望有了不同的期许机遇也更广泛

sentences.en: life is inevitable. It happens all the time.
sentences.zh: 机遇也更广泛你珍惜并重视师生间的情谊

sentences.en: You take an area, a school, a district, you change the conditions, give people a different sense of possibility, a different set of expectations, a broader range of opportunities, you cherish and value the relationships between teachers and learners,
sentences.zh: 你珍惜并重视师生间的情谊你给予人们自主权来发挥创造力革新他们的成果学校里曾一度缺失这种盎然生机卓越的领导者清楚这一点在教育体系中领导者的真正作用无论在国家级，州级

sentences.en: you offer people the discretion to be creative and to innovate in what they do, and schools that were once bereft spring to life.
sentences.zh: 无论在国家级，州级还是校级上其真正作用不是也不应是指挥和控制

sentences.en: Great leaders know that. The real role of leadership in education -- and I think it's true at the national level, the state level, at the school level -- is not and should not be command and control.
sentences.zh: 其真正作用不是也不应是指挥和控制领导者的真正作用是控制教育的风气制造一种充满可能性的倾向如果你这样做了，人们便会追随实现你预料不到，也不曾期待过的

sentences.en: The real role of leadership is climate control, creating a climate of possibility.
sentences.zh: 实现你预料不到，也不曾期待过的成果在此引用本杰明富兰克林的一句格言“世界上有三种人

sentences.en: And if you do that, people will rise to it and achieve things that you completely did not anticipate and couldn't have expected.
sentences.zh: “世界上有三种人第一种人雷打不动得不到是因为他们不想要他们力求不变第二种人伺机而动

sentences.en: There's a wonderful quote from Benjamin Franklin.
sentences.zh: 第二种人伺机而动他们认识到改变的必要性准备去做

sentences.en: "There are three sorts of people in the world: Those who are immovable, people who don't get it, or don't want to do anything about it; there are people who are movable, people who see the need for change and are prepared to listen to it;
sentences.zh: 准备去做第三种人先发制人他们主动让事情发生”如果我们可以鼓励更多的人去做那将会成为一场运动如果这场运动有足够的执行力度从最好的角度来看，那将会是一场革命

sentences.en: and there are people who move, people who make things happen."
sentences.zh: 从最好的角度来看，那将会是一场革命而这正是我们所需要的谢谢大家

sentences.en: And if we can encourage more people, that will be a movement.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家（掌声）

sentences.en: And if the movement is strong enough, that's, in the best sense of the word, a revolution.
sentences.zh: 谢谢（掌声）

sentences.en: And that's what we need. Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 谢谢（掌声）

sentences.en: (Applause) Thank you very much. (Applause)
sentences.zh: （鼓掌）非常感谢。 （掌声）
